caption:
Toto has been serving all summer, and the arm feels heavy after every set. 🎾

Tennis loads the same spots over and over: grip through the forearm, serving through the back of the shoulder, footwork through the calves. Remedial massage can help those areas feel looser, though the effect is usually short-term.

Hybi's plan: lighter massage a day or two before a tournament, deeper work after. Pair it with calf raises and forearm and shoulder strength work so your body copes with more hitting.

Elbow pain lasting weeks or shoulder pain at night is worth a physio assessment first. Our remedial massage therapists work alongside our physios at Hybrid Physio. Book online via the link in bio.
